# v3 results (auto-generated by scripts/06_report.py)

* Library: 100 metrics; 10 constant on this data; 42 cluster representatives (|Spearman| ≥ 0.95); 24 candidates after the anchor-agreement floor.
* Anchor: synthetic anchors (12813 answers, 20 operators) across 14 datasets (including the 7 datasets whose model predictions are still pending).
* Selected metrics: tok_f1, num_decay_2p5, bigram_rec (LODO Spearman with utility 0.882; native typed metric alone 0.811; EM alone 0.822).
* Grid: step 0.02 × 5 hedge penalties = 6,630 weightings; top 100 kept. Ensemble mean weights: tok_f1 0.16, num_decay_2p5 0.81, bigram_rec 0.03; mean λ 0.63.
* Objective terms (ensemble mean): anchor ρ 0.906, AUC 0.997, cross-dataset JS 0.053, wrong→ 0.022, native τ 0.678.

## Caveats

* 4 models × 40 items on the 7 datasets with predictions; ranks below the top are not separable (see CIs).
* 7 datasets have anchors but no model predictions yet (run `scripts/00_run_models.py`).
* The anchor utility scale is hand-set (stated in `src/anchors/ladder.py`) and perturbed above; human labels can replace it via `02_select_metrics.py --labels`.
* The native typed metric scores as high as the ensemble on the mixed objective because it wins the native-fidelity term by construction; the ensemble wins on anchor agreement, AUC and wrong→0.
